 Nintendo eShop and Switch Online Launches in PH 
 Nintendo eShop and Switch Online Launches in PH
 Written By Sofie 
 Published • November 10th, 2026 
 News 
 0 
 Short URL: https://manilashaker.com/ms/5e5e 
 Nintendo is officially launching its eShop and Switch Online services in the Philippines today, November 10, 2026.
 The launch will allow Filipino players to purchase digital games and subscribe to online services without having to change their Nintendo account region.
 However, Nintendo has yet to announce local pricing, accepted payment methods, available membership plans, and the initial game lineup.
 As of now, some network services may be temporarily unavailable.
 Nintendo has also scheduled network maintenance for November 11, which may affect services such as acquiring stage data.
 Meanwhile, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand are scheduled to receive their Nintendo eShop and Switch Online services on November 18, 2026.
